# openwrt_network_interface (Resource)

Manages an OpenWrt network interface.

### Example

```hcl
# Static LAN interface
resource "openwrt_network_interface" "lan" {
  name    = "lan"
  proto   = "static"
  device  = "br-lan"
  ipaddr  = ["192.168.1.1/24"]
  gateway = "192.168.1.254"
  dns     = ["8.8.8.8", "1.1.1.1"]
  metric  = 100
  auto    = "1"
}

# Multi-IP interface (multiple addresses on one interface)
resource "openwrt_network_interface" "lan_multi" {
  name    = "lan"
  proto   = "static"
  device  = "br-lan"
  ipaddr  = ["192.168.1.1/24", "10.0.0.1/24"]
  gateway = "192.168.1.254"
}

# DHCP client interface
resource "openwrt_network_interface" "wan" {
  name   = "wan"
  proto  = "dhcp"
  device = "eth0"
  metric = 100
  auto   = "1"
}
```

## Import

```bash
terraform import openwrt_network_interface.lan lan
```

## Full Examples

See [examples/network-interfaces](../../examples/network-interfaces/) for more complete configurations.

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the interface (e.g., 'lan', 'wan', 'guest').
- `proto` (String) Protocol: 'static', 'dhcp', 'dhcpv6', 'pppoe', 'wireguard', 'qmi', etc.

### Optional

- `auto` (String) Enable interface on boot ('0' or '1').
- `bridge_empty` (Boolean) Allow empty bridge (no ports).
- `delegate` (Boolean) Enable IPv6 delegation (default: true).
- `device` (String) Network device (e.g., 'eth0', 'br-lan', 'wg0').
- `dns` (List of String) DNS server(s) (e.g., ['8.8.8.8', '1.1.1.1']).
- `gateway` (String) Default gateway IP address.
- `ip6addr` (List of String) IPv6 address(es) with prefix (e.g., ['fd00::1/64', '2001:db8::1/64']).
- `ip6assign` (String) IPv6 prefix length to assign to downstream (e.g., '60').
- `ip6gateway` (String) IPv6 default gateway.
- `ip6prefix` (String) IPv6 prefix for downstream delegation.
- `ipaddr` (List of String) IPv4 address(es) with prefix (e.g., ['192.168.1.1/24', '10.0.0.1/24']).
- `metric` (Number) Route metric for this interface.
- `type` (String) Interface type ('bridge', 'bonding', etc.).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal ID: network/<interface_name>.
